description: Upper-bound frame stiffness: bonded inserts/pads, rigid moving axes and kinematic guide/drive patch equations. Patch coupling stiffens the rail/seat regions.

mineral-cast.source: MaterialLibrary modulus/density; Poisson ratio is an explicit study assumption

overrides.source: Explicit study assumption; no library value

machined-steel.source: Study isotropic machined-steel assumption: E=210 GPa, nu=0.30; density=7850 kg/m3 retained from MaterialLibrary. No material certificate supplied.

overrides.source: Explicit study assumption; no library value
Explicit study steel modulus; no library value

limitations: Casting-to-insert interfaces and the four column pad pairs are perfectly bonded; no preload, slip, uplift or anchorage strength is calculated
Moving X/Y stage, Z carriage/head, spindle, tool and workholding are rigid; guides transmit transverse loads and drives carry their axis loads without elastic compliance
Foot annuli represent physically rigid nuts, with all foot rotations free; support configurations bracket a three-point mount and four assumed vertical springs.
Cutting forces are applied at coincident tool/workpiece reference points; a rigid fixture reaches the current tool-tip height above the table
Gravity of omitted components is transferred to the nearest represented ancestor, conserving force and moment; static self-weight is only an assumed assembly allocation
All elastic properties are assumed; this solve supplies frame compliance for this pose and these boundary conditions

soft-three-point.description: Three point kinematic bound; foot rotations free and fourth foot vertically free

stiff-four-springs.description: Four vertical springs leveled under self-weight; foot rotations free
stiff-four-springs.source: Assumed stiff support bracket, not measured foot stiffness
stiff-four-springs.leveling: Zero loaded foot heights under self-weight; spring precompression Ri/k is represented by equal/opposite equivalent initial spring forces (calibrated four-seat gravity reactions). Ground DOFs stay zero.

frameShareTarget.rationale: Provisional 30% casting contribution to the machine loop; assess nose and short stiff test bar. Cutter cases are context only. Low share permits lightening studies after modal and travel gates, not an automatic stiffness increase.
frameShareTarget.decisionBasis: Machine loop excluding job-dependent cutter: spindle nose and short stiff test bar, both supports and all travel poses
